newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania revises 1996 economic growth to 4.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania revises 1996 economic growth to 4.8 pct.

text.p: Romania revised its forecast for 1996 gross domestic product (GDP) growth to 4.8 percent from 4.5 percent, a government official said on Wednesday.

"We projected GDP growth will be 4.8 percent compared with a previous estimate of 4.5 percent," government spokesman Ioan Rosca told a news conference after the cabinet meeting which also revised the 1996 state budget.
Last year Romania's economy expanded by 6.9 percent, up from 3.9 percent in 1994. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
